body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Cresyn presented ''CS-EP250'' jewelry-type earphone during KES 2006, targeting female users. It is expected to be on the market at the end of October. Suggesting price is 18,000(KRW).

< AVING Special Report Team for ''KES 2006'': Publisher & Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Gaius Park, Phoebe Kwon, Sheri Choi, Joshua Shim, Daniel Sirh, Rose Kim, Paul Kim, Samuel Kim, Abe Shim, Grace Won >
